title: Intent List
description: Reply to `fdc3.discoverability.discoverIntents` on app channel `fdc3.discoverability`. Catalog of intent names the caller may raise, with purpose, display, and result-type hints.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Short explanation of when to raise this intent. Sourced from a non-standard `purpose` field on each App Directory `interop.intents.listensFor` entry.

contexts.title: Contexts
contexts.description: Optional context `type` strings this intent accepts.

resultType.title: Result type
resultType.description: Optional IntentResult context `type`, or `channel` when the result is a PrivateChannel.

intents.name: AskAgent
intents.purpose: Start an AI agent session that can plan and call FDC3 tools for a natural-language query.

intents.name: ViewChart
intents.purpose: Show a price chart for an instrument.
